body.name: Uniform-design linear-response full-data witness
body.construction: Under \(P_0^{\mathrm F}\), let \(W\) be uniform on \([0,1]^d\), let \(A\) be uniform on \([0,1]\) and independent of \((W,R_0)\), and set \(Y(a)=c_{\theta}(a-1/2)+\sqrt{v_{\kappa}}R_0\) and \(Y=Y(A)\). Take \(\mu^{\mathrm F}(a,w)=m_0(a,w)\). Let \(P_0\) be its observed \((W,A,Y)\)-marginal; under \(P_0\), the primitive functions are \(p=1\), \(g=1\), \(m=m_0\), and \(r=r_0\).
